components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Card
components.description: Base elevated surface for grouped content; single ambient shadow, 15px radius.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 15px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(15,23,42,.05); }

components.name: List Row
components.description: Signature content primitive: icon chip + title/description + chevron, used for module lists and history across the app.
components.css: .ds-list-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; padding: 14px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E2E8F0; background: none; text-align: left; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-list-row:hover { background: #F8FAFC; } .ds-list-row-icon { width: 38px; height: 38px; flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(2,132,199,0.1); color: #0284C7; } .ds-list-row-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-list-row-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #0F172A; } .ds-list-row-desc { font-size: 12px; color: #475569; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input with body-safe placeholder color (post-review AA fix).

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: CSS-text logo; Two-T Rule gradient confined to the two capital T's, rest in Midnight Navy.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark-t { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0284C7, #38BDF8); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; } .ds-wordmark-rest { color: #0F172A; }

narrative.overview: Arctic Blue is one technician workspace rendered as a single calm instrument panel, not six tool sites stitched under one logo. The thesis the build actually carries: restraint over decoration. Surfaces are flat, near-white panels on a cool arctic-gray canvas; the only color event on a screen is the Arctic Blue accent marking the active destination, an icon chip, or a primary action. Everything else stays in a narrow neutral range so the accent reads as signal, not noise. The build confirms the brief's own anti-references: no gradients, no neon, no glass, no decorative shapes, no strong shadows. Dark theme is a fully specified second token set, not a tinted afterthought.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, bordered surfaces — one hairline border, one soft shadow, no shadow scale
A single accent color per theme, used sparingly (active nav, icon tint, primary button, focus ring)
Tiered radii, not a flat corner value — small chips, mid cards, large panels, and buttons each round differently
Inter for all UI text; JetBrains Mono reserved strictly for code/commands
Confirmed rejections: gradients (outside the wordmark), neon lighting, glass/blur effects, decorative shapes, strong shadows, glyph-icon fonts

rules.name: The Two-T Rule
rules.body: Gradient is permitted in exactly one place in the entire system: the two capital T's of the "TecTools" wordmark. Nowhere else. The square TT.png icon mark and every other surface stay flat.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Each theme has exactly one primary accent (Arctic Blue light / Sky Blue dark) carrying all interactive-state color. Teal is a reserved secondary, not a second interactive color.

rules.name: The One-Face Rule
rules.body: Inter carries every UI role from H1 down to helper text; there is no separate display/headline typeface.

rules.name: The Single-Shadow Rule
rules.body: One ambient shadow token exists and it is the same shadow everywhere elevation is needed. No hover-lift, directional, or stacked shadows.

dos: Do use the single ambient shadow token (--shadow-light) for every elevated surface; do not create a second shadow tier.
Do use --text-secondary for any body-adjacent or placeholder text; it is the only text-muted-range token verified at AA contrast.
Do keep the wordmark gradient confined to the two T's (Two-T Rule); everywhere else stays flat.
Do reuse the .list-row / .card / .empty-state primitives for new modules rather than inventing new list or stub patterns.
Do respect the tiered radius scale (12/15/18/10px) by component scale, not a single flat radius.
donts: Don't apply gradients, neon color, glass/blur, or decorative shapes anywhere outside the wordmark's two T's.
Don't use --text-muted for body text, descriptions, or placeholders — it is chrome-only and previously caused an AA contrast failure when misused as body text.
Don't use hard-offset or strong/dramatic shadows, or stack multiple shadow layers on one surface.
Don't introduce glyph-icon fonts or a second icon family; the system uses exactly one hand-authored line-icon set.
Don't invent module-specific content or components for the stub modules — they are honest empty states until their own phase builds them.
